inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed parts of outside area grass not maintained. Children are unable to see where they are stepping at in the grassy areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Observed medication on the table where the children were sitting and eating at. NOTE: This medication was moved and put up out of reach of the children during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §747.3935(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The current CPR card of the permit holder did not include the required test off on a manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Observed a child receiving a diaper change and did not wash their hands afterwards. NOTE: This was corrected during inspection once the inspector mentioned washing the child's hand after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A food allergy emergency plan is needed for one child enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver has not completed thirty hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: The permit holder has not completed monthly tests of the carbon detection system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year: The permit holder has not completed sheltering drills for severe weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The permit holder has not completed monthly fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The permit holder has not completed monthly smoke detector testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: The permit holder did not have a record of attendance for children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One admission record was evaluated during today's inspection and the following information is needed:    An address for the emergency contact, the emergency care name, address, and phone number, authorization for emergency medical care, special needs statement, and a statement of food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The permit holder completed pediatric CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The permit holder has not completed monthly inspections of the fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: The permit holder has not completed lock down drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The permit holders pediatric first aid training expired 8/29/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation did not have documentation of safety drills available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The primary caregiver needed training in the following topics:    -Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and      -Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: Documentation of the annual certification was not available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §747.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Admission forms are needed for three children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience: The primary caregiver needed three hours of training in management techniques, leadership, or staff supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver needed training in all health and safety topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The area designated for childcare use was not equipeed with a working smoke detection system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
